samples.summary: verify-consumer's auto-build only builds the SHELL, but the fixture now resolves the package through `exports` → `dist/plugin/index.js`
samples.evidence: `buildShellIfMissing()` (packages/design-editor/scripts/verify-consumer.mjs:197-206) runs only `vite build --config ./vite.shell.config.ts`; the plugin half of `build` (`tsc -p tsconfig.build.json`, packages/design-editor/package.json:20-21) is never run. `boot()` (verify-consumer.mjs:117-128) starts vite on `fixtures/consumer/vite.config.ts`, which imports the package BY NAME (packages/design-editor/fixtures/consumer/vite.config.ts:17) and therefore resolves `exports["."] = ./dist/plugin/index.js` (packages/design-editor/package.json:6-10). On a clean checkout `dist/plugin/` does not exist, so the dev server dies and the gate reports `dev server exited early` instead of a verdict; worse, when `dist/plugin` exists but is older than `src/plugin`, the freshness check (which only stats `dist/shell/index.html`, line 198-199) lets the whole 57-check gate pass against STALE plugin bytes — exactly the failure the comment at lines 189-196 says is worse than no gate. The delta's new comment at line 171 asserts the build is covered by the `design-editor:build` lane, but this script is explicitly out of verify:fast/verify:self (line 24-29), so no lane builds anything before it runs. Fix belongs here: build (or staleness-check) `dist/plugin` too.

samples.summary: verify-scenes rebuilds only design-editor's shell, but the vite config it boots now imports the package's built plugin entry
samples.evidence: `buildShellIfStale()` (packages/design-sandbox/scripts/verify-scenes.mjs:66-87) stats only `packages/design-editor/dist/shell/index.html` and rebuilds only `vite.shell.config.ts`. `boot()` (line 89-93) then starts vite on `packages/design-sandbox/vite.config.ts`, which does `import { designEditor, BASE } from '@wafflebase/design-editor'` (packages/design-sandbox/vite.config.ts:49) — since #966 that resolves to `dist/plugin/index.js`. On a checkout where only the shell exists (which this very function can produce), the config fails to load and the script reports `dev server exited early: Cannot find module …/dist/plugin/index.js`. It builds `@wafflebase/core` when stale (line 204-218) but has no equivalent for the plugin dist.

samples.summary: verify-tokens boots vite with no design-editor build at all; only `predev` covers the plugin dist
samples.evidence: `boot()` (packages/design-sandbox/scripts/verify-tokens.mjs:97-108) spawns `pnpm exec vite` in `packages/design-sandbox`, loading `vite.config.ts:49`'s `import … from '@wafflebase/design-editor'` → `dist/plugin/index.js`. The package only prebuilds design-editor for `dev` (`predev`, packages/design-sandbox/package.json:10); `verify:tokens` (line 12) and `verify:scenes` (line 13) have no such hook, so on an unbuilt checkout these manual gates fail on a missing module rather than on the thing under test. The delta added `design-editor:build` for exactly this class of failure in CI lanes but left these two entry points reaching the same dist without it.

That package's `exports` map points at its `.ts` files", but `exports["."]` now names `./dist/plugin/index.js` / `./dist/plugin/index.d.ts` (packages/design-editor/package.json:6-10). samples.summary: Comment documents the pre-#966 loading behaviour (config loads the package as stripped TypeScript source)
samples.evidence: packages/design-sandbox/scripts/verify-tokens.mjs:83-88 says "A Vite config that imports `@wafflebase/design-editor` is handed to Node as TypeScript source … Node's own type stripping loads the `.ts`". verdict.reason: Verified independently. verify-consumer.mjs:197-206 stats and rebuilds only dist/shell/index.html via vite.shell.config.ts; build:plugin (tsc -p tsconfig.build.json, package.json:20) is never run. The fixture config imports the package by name (fixtures/consumer/vite.config.ts:17) and self-references through exports["."] = ./dist/plugin/index.js (package.json:6-10) — there is no fixtures/consumer/package.json, so the nearest manifest is the design-editor package itself. dist/ is absent from the checkout and gitignored, so boot() (lines 117-128, throw at 135) dies with 'dev server exited early' on a clean tree; and when a stale dist/plugin exists the shell-only freshness check (198-199) lets all checks pass on stale plugin bytes. No lane runs the build first: verify:consumer appears only as the package script (package.json:22) and in no verify-self lane, contradicting the comment at verify-consumer.mjs:170-172. verify-self.mjs:303-317 and design-editor-packaging.md:151-152 confirm the exports repoint to dist and that every consumer now needs the plugin build. Real, reachable, and a changed-contract consumer left broken — blocking under the blast-radius rubric.

verdict.reason: The finding is accurate as described. `packages/design-editor/package.json:6-14` maps `exports["."]` to `./dist/plugin/index.js`, produced only by `build:plugin` (line 20). `packages/design-sandbox/vite.config.ts:49` imports the bare package at config-load time, so booting that config requires `dist/plugin/index.js`. `verify-scenes.mjs:66-87` stats only `dist/shell/index.html` and rebuilds only `vite.shell.config.ts` — which emits `dist/shell`, never `dist/plugin` — and `main()` (221-224) then calls `boot()` (89-100), which spawns vite on that config and reports `dev server exited early` on a config-load failure. `buildCoreIfStale()` (204-219) covers only `@wafflebase/core`; nothing covers the plugin dist. No guard elsewhere rescues it: `packages/design-sandbox/package.json:10-13` has `predev` for `dev` but no pre-hook for `verify:scenes`, and `harness.config.json:48` itself states that since #966 anything resolving `@wafflebase/design-editor` needs a `design-editor:build` edge — verify:scenes has none. `dist` is gitignored (.gitignore:96) and absent from this checkout, so the failure path is the current state, not hypothetical. This is a caller of a changed export contract left unupdated — in-lane for blast radius, and impact is a gate that cannot run (or, on a dirty tree, runs against stale plugin bytes), i.e. major.
